title: Pillar of Ash
wikitext:
[[Image:The Pillar of Ash.jpg|thumb|300px|The Pillar of Ash.]]
'''The Pillar of Ash''' is the name for a group of [[orc]] structures near the middle of the [[Burning Steppes]]. The pillar itself might refer to the tall tower filled to the brim with hostile [[Blackrock Clan|Blackrock]] orcs. The only other object of interest here is a huge statue of a [[human]] hero, sword raised in the direction of [[Blackrock Mountain]] - most likely marking the spot where [[Anduin Lothar]] fell in battle.
